name: brain-ctx-monorepo
description: brain.ctx — AI Constitution Standard. Monorepo containing Python + Node libraries.
author: Bomberedman <hello@manasdb.com>

scripts.build: npm run sync-spec && npm run build:node
scripts.test: npm run test:python && npm run test:node
scripts.validate-examples:
python -c "
import yaml, json, jsonschema, pathlib
schema = json.load(open('spec/brain-ctx.schema.json'))
for f in pathlib.Path('examples').rglob('brain.ctx'):
    data = yaml.safe_load(f.read_text())
    jsonschema.validate(data, schema)
    print(f'✓ {f}')
"
